Bring drawings. They will tell you what waterjet should take and what belongs on plasma.
Find them at 11 Hagerty Blvd, West Chester, PA 19382. Call (610) 544-9750. Hours: Monday-Friday 7AM – 3:30 PM. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.
